verdict.rationale: Simular documents running Sai on hosted cloud Windows computers via the API, and separately on your own device through BYOD on Mac or Windows. A developer could therefore try tasks on a cloud machine before pointing the agent at a real device. However, the evidence never calls these cloud computers sandboxed or isolated VMs, and never describes containers or a deliberate test-then-promote workflow. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/isolation guarantees for the cloud computers, container or self-hosted VM support, a documented flow for moving from a cloud test run to a real device, and independent hands-on corroboration.
